decisive_items: estimated pulmonary arterial pressure of 60 mmHg
response.rationale: Acute right ventricular strain with elevated pulmonary artery pressure and new RBBB, plus transient ST elevation and normal coronary arteries, is most consistent with pulmonary embolism. Takotsubo does not explain the pulmonary hypertension/RV strain, and ACS is excluded by the normal angiogram.

rejected.why: Takotsubo may cause ST elevation and normal coronary arteries but would not explain right ventricular dilatation and pulmonary arterial pressure of 60 mmHg with new RBBB.
Acute coronary syndrome is directly contradicted by coronary angiography showing normal coronary arteries without stenosis, and the RV strain pattern favors pulmonary embolism.
